learning_outcomes.text: Students will be familiar with the fundamentals of linear algebra needed in informatics and computer graphics.

syllabus_topics: The concept of a group, specific matrix groups.
Scalar product, vector product in 3-dimensional space.

assessment_methods.method: Continuous assessment (graded homework, quizzes, activities in exercises, midterms)

assessment_rules: To take the final exam, the student must obtain at least 55% of points from the semester. For the examination, the student must obtain at least 50% of the points from the written part. Approximate scale: A 90%, B 80%, C 70%, D 60%, E 55%.
